title: European Conference for Science Journalists (ECSJ) 2026 Travel Grant
description: A travel grant from the European Federation for Science Journalism (EFSJ) supporting young journalists to attend the European Conference of Science Journalism (ECSJ), held alongside the WISSENSWERTE science journalism conference at Herrenhausen Palace in Hanover, Germany, 14-16 October 2026. Grants of EUR 400-500 are awarded to help cover travel costs. Applicants must be 35 or under and working as journalists with an interest in science journalism; apply by emailing a CV and a half-page motivation letter in English to info@efsj.eu with the subject "Travel Grants ECSJ". Note: the grant is specifically for travel -- conference registration is a separate cost (early-bird day/combo tickets range from about EUR 70 to EUR 200, with discounted rates for journalism trainees/students and for members of partner journalism associations), so grant recipients should budget for a modest registration fee on top of the travel grant. Notification of results is expected mid-September 2026. Application deadline: 25 August 2026.
visaNote: This is short-term conference attendance, not employment; confirm visitor-entry requirements for Germany based on your nationality.
